# Belken

> Belken (BelKen Ventures Inc) builds and runs autonomous operations for local service businesses. Its flagship offer, OpenClaw, is a production-grade multi-agent system custom-designed for how a business runs and operated by Belken. The AI Receptionist is its ready-to-deploy product: an AI phone receptionist pre-tuned for local service businesses such as plumbers, HVAC companies, roofers, and electricians.

## What the AI Receptionist does

Belken sets up and runs each of these for the shop:

- Answers every call 24/7 in the business's own name, including nights and weekends.
- Books appointments straight onto the business's Google or Outlook calendar, and sends the owner a text for every call.
- Recognizes emergencies, flags them as urgent, and transfers urgent calls to the owner's or the on-call tech's cell.
- Texts the caller a confirmation, and texts missed callers back in about 60 seconds.
- Calls the business's past customers by name to rebook them, and follows up on open estimates.
- Requests reviews automatically.
- Never makes up prices.
- The business keeps its existing phone number. Setup starts with one 15-minute call. Belken wires it into the tools a business already uses (calendar, CRM, phone) and operates it for the customer.

## How pricing works

- Free Operations Assessment: $0, 20 minutes, no pitch.
- Opportunity Audit and 90-Day Roadmap: $1,997 one-time. A deep diagnostic, the top 5 to 7 automation targets, a conservative ROI model, and a prioritized 90-day roadmap.
- Autonomous Operations Retainer: starting at $4,500 per month. Design, build, deploy, and operate, with monthly reporting on jobs booked, hours reclaimed, and revenue recovered. The AI Receptionist is included in the retainer, with no per-minute meter.
